// property: Your Search Console property, EXACTLY as it appears in GSC.
// urlsFile: File holding the URLs to request-index (one per line, # = comment).
// limit: Max URLs to process per run. Google caps request-indexing at ~10-12/day.
// cooldownDays: Don't re-request a URL submitted within this many days.
// sitemap: Optional fallback: a local path or http(s) sitemap URL to pull URLs from when urlsFile is empty.
